theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {s t : Finset α} [DecidableEq α] (h : s ⋖ t) : ∃ a ∈ t, t.erase a = s := by
  let h_subset := h.1
  let h_ne := h.2
  let h_diff_nonempty := (h_subset.2 h_ne).nonempty
  let a := classical.choice h_diff_nonempty
  let h_a_in_t : a ∈ t := (mem_of_mem_diff_left h_diff_nonempty).1
  let h_a_not_in_s : a ∉ s := (mem_of_mem_diff_right h_diff_nonempty).2
  have h_erase_eq : t.erase a = s := by
    rw [erase_eq_insert_iff.1 h_a_not_in_s]
    exact eq_insert_self _ _
  exact ⟨a, h_a_in_t, h_erase_eq⟩
